amy: Starting a config-only rollout now — small canary for routing + batching changes. Change window 30m; canary 5% -> ramp to 20% -> 100% if metrics look good. Will pin the routing policy for the set.
kevin: copying. which routes/tenants are in the canary?
mira: brief note: please call out batching.window_ms and timeout_ms in the changelist so we can correlate.
amy: canary targets: routes matching route: 'generation.*' and tenants in cohort 'canary-20'. Config diff below.
amy: ```json
{
  "routing_policy": "weighted_v2",
  "batching_window_ms": 40,
  "max_batch_tokens": 1024,
  "timeout_ms": 4500,
  "tenant_floor": 0.02,
  "kv_cache_prefetch": true
}
```
amy: deploy command: `/deploy config-only --change-id=cfg-2026-0319-07 --canary=5% --steps=5m,15m,30m --pin-version=route-v2`
deploy-bot: Canary initiated: cfg-2026-0319-07 — 5% traffic to weighted_v2 on generation routes. Instances: 8 canary pods, rolling. Started at 1716004321.
mira: quick telemetry update: p50 unchanged, p95 +75ms on canary at t+3m, error rate steady at 0.08%. No increased 5xx.
sre-oncall: watching KV cache hit rate and memory on canary nodes — set alert if mem > 78% or kv_miss_rate spikes > 0.5%.
kevin: if p95 stays < +120ms and errors < 0.5% we can go to 20%. ack from me if metrics look stable at next check.
julia: rollbook note: rollback plan is to revert routing_policy to weighted_v1 and reduce batching_window_ms back to 80ms; rollback command handy: `/deploy rollback cfg-2026-0319-07 --immediate`
mira: obs: at t+12m p95 is +62ms, cpu on canary nodes +6%, kv_miss_rate down slightly. Looks fine.
amy: ramping to 20% now. executing step.
deploy-bot: Canary step complete — 20% traffic applied to weighted_v2. Time: 1716009120. Monitoring for 15m.
sre-oncall: no memory issues, no OOMs. network egress stable.
kevin: thumbs up from me. proceed to full rollout after 15m of stable metrics.
amy: publishing short release note in channel: "Config-only: routing policy switch to weighted_v2 for generation.*, batching.window_ms reduced to 40ms to improve throughput tail, client timeout increased to 4.5s to accommodate longer latency tails, enabled kv_cache_prefetch to reduce repeated model load cost."
julia: noted — added rollback criteria to release ticket: error_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m OR p95 increase > 200ms sustained 5m triggers auto-rollback veto.
deploy-bot: Canary passed stability checks (15m). Scheduling full rollout: will complete to 100% in 10 minutes unless a veto is posted.
mira: monitoring loop active. nothing to veto. :white_check_mark:
amy: final: rolled to 100% at 1716010322. closing change window. tagging release ticket #4521 and noting config diff above. :rocket:
